detailed_description: Aspect Ratio Resizer helps you resize images to specific dimensions while maintaining or changing the aspect ratio. Includes presets for common ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1) and social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter).
usage_steps: Upload an image using the file input
Enter custom width and height or use presets
Toggle aspect ratio lock as needed
Click Download to save the resized image
usage_examples: Resize photos for social media posts
